description: List operational expenses (gastos operacionales) of an organization with their category, plus totals broken down by category type (FIJO/VARIABLE/COSTO_PRODUCTO/PROVISION). Filter by date range (dateFrom/dateTo), category id, type(s), or recurring-only. Read-only — complements finance_list_cobros/finance_list_payments (income side) to complete the financial picture.
name: finance_list_gastos
